messages.subject: MRDS truncation bug
parts:
Dear List=20

I am using Distance 6.0 on cetacean aerial survey. I get an error message=
when I try to right truncate my observations in the MRDS engine.

The error looks like this

Error in plot.io(ddf.5, lwd =3D 2, lty =3D 1, pch =3D 1, cex =3D 1) :
dims [product 33] do not match the length of object [34]

And then an additionally (yellow) warning

In addition: Warning messages:
1: In p1^model$mr$data$detected[model$mr$data$observer =3D=3D 1] :
longer object length is not a multiple of shorter object length
2: In (1 - p1)^(1 - model$mr$data$detected[model$mr$data$observer =3D=3D =
:
longer object length is not a multiple of shorter object length
3: In p2^model$mr$data$detected[model$mr$data$observer =3D=3D 2] :
longer object length is not a multiple of shorter object length
4: In (1 - p2)^(1 - model$mr$data$detected[model$mr$data$observer =3D=3D =
:
longer object length is not a multiple of shorter object length
5: In p0 * detfct.pooled.values :
longer object length is not a multiple of shorter object length
Execution halted


Has anybody experienced this before and have a solution?

Thanks,
Rikke



Rikke Guldborg Hansen
